name: Buddy Target Op Set v0
description: Denominator for issue #911 coverage percentage. v0 seeds common dense-Transformer ATen symbols plus MoE-critical routing/dispatch/index ops. Expand via workload traces before claiming 90%+.
denominator_rule: Unique aten overload keys listed in this file (families may group aliases; coverage is counted per listed key).
fully_supported_rule_live: frontend_recognized AND lowered AND compiled AND correctness_validated

transformer_core.description: Dense Transformer / LLM decode-prefill building blocks

moe_critical.description: MoE routing, top-k, expert dispatch/combine, scatter/gather, dynamic index

vision_transformer_extra.description: ViT / multimodal extras beyond dense LLM core

known_partial_or_limited.topk.default: Often shape/k-attr limited; validate expert routing sizes.
known_partial_or_limited.scatter.reduce: Reduce mode / dtype coverage may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited.scatter_reduce.two: Reduce mode / dtype coverage may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited.index_put.default: Accumulate / advanced indexing may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited.index.Tensor: Advanced indexing / None / boolean masks may be partial.
known_partial_or_limited._scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_for_: CPU flash path; GPU/other backends may differ.
known_partial_or_limited.fill_cache.default: Buddy KV-cache helper; not a generic ATen public op.
known_partial_or_limited.update_cache.default: Buddy KV-cache helper; not a generic ATen public op.
known_partial_or_limited.one_hot.default: May be missing or decomposed; verify frontend map.
known_partial_or_limited.bincount.default: May be missing; MoE load-balance analytics often need it.
known_partial_or_limited.argsort.default: May be missing; routing sometimes uses sort/topk instead.
known_partial_or_limited.index_add.default: MoE combine path; verify frontend + lowering.
known_partial_or_limited.index_copy.default: MoE dispatch path; verify frontend + lowering.
known_partial_or_limited.contiguous.default: Often elided; treated as alias of clone.default when present.
known_partial_or_limited.reshape.default: FX often emits view.default; tracked via decomp_aliases.
known_partial_or_limited.softmax.default: FX often emits _softmax.default; tracked via decomp_aliases.
known_partial_or_limited.pad.default: Often lowers via constant_pad_nd; tracked via decomp_aliases.

workload_notes: Dense Transformer: BuddyLlama / BuddyQwen3 / BuddyTransformer examples.
MoE: prioritize DeepSeek-style expert routing; BuddyDeepSeekR1 / BuddyTensorParallel are starting points.
Do not count frontend mapping alone as fully supported for the 90% target once live mode is enabled.
